evidence.text: The dictionary says 桌 is not recorded in Shuowen. It gives furniture and classifier senses, illustrating the furniture sense with a Three Kingdoms novel passage and the classifier sense with Ming-era novels. These are cited textual examples, not proof that the pictured spelling is the earliest form of the furniture word.

evidence.text: The entry treats 棹 as a variant spelling for the table/stand sense. It cites 正字通’s 倚棹/倚卓 spellings, 楊億《談苑》’s report of 檀香倚卓 during 咸平、景德 (998–1007), and a later dictionary explanation that 桌 is related in sound to 卓 and takes 木 for the furniture. This is a secondary report of cited sources; it does not show that the graph 桌 itself occurred in the early passage.

evidence.text: This Qing compilation, under 椅桌, quotes 楊億《談苑》 for 檀香倚卓 in 咸平、景德 and reports later accounts of 卓/棹 spellings. The page identifies the work as Qing, so it is a later compilation preserving reports, not an inspected Song manuscript witness.

evidence.text: The entry gathers reported examples including 楊億《談苑》’s 檀香倚卓 for 咸平、景德, a 卓子 poem, and later 卓子/棹 spellings. Its editor’s note says 桌 was not seen before the Yuan. These are a historical lexicon’s reports and editorial judgment, not an exhaustive corpus result or proof of a dated 桌 graph.

gaps: No pre-Qin graph or furniture sense for 桌 is established by inspected sources. The local Baxter–Sagart row marks no pre-Qin examples; no external ancient 桌 witness was verified in this pass.

The reported 998–1007 倚卓 furniture term is not the same evidence as a dated graph 桌. Its exact manuscript witness and earliest spelling remain unverified; secondary sources report later Southern Song 棹 forms and a Ming-era 桌 dictionary entry.

Accounts differ over whether 桌 arose by adding semantic 木 to 卓, derived from an older 卓 form, or developed through vernacular orthography. The proposed merging/replacement of 卓’s 十 by 木 is not supported by the sources inspected.

Current Mandarin rows supplied locally are 卓 zhuó, 桌 zhuō, 棹 zhào. Baxter–Sagart exact local rows are 卓 MC traewk, OC *tˤrawk and 桌 MC traewk, OC *tˤrawk (no pre-Qín exx.); these are local data, not ancient proof of the component role. Unicode official records for 卓 and 桌 were not successfully inspected in this run, so no external click-through evidence is added for those local readings.
The classifier sense for dishes/guests is present in cited novel examples, but the date of its earliest use and its pathway from the furniture noun are not established here.

No glyph image is proposed. Available 卓 Commons image candidates returned 404 at acquisition; the official Xiaoxuetang query for 桌 returned 401, and the ZDIC old-script index did not establish a 桌 image. Thus no alternative image with verified identity and rights was established.

limitations.text: No usable glyph image candidate was established for 桌. The previous 卓-bronze.svg and 卓-seal.svg requests returned 404 and are excluded. Xiaoxuetang’s supplied query for 桌 returned 401. ZDIC labels old-script categories but its displayed forms are for 卓, so they cannot be represented as historical 桌 forms. The searched sources did not provide an alternate exact image URL with verified identity and reuse rights.
